segments.contextAfter: ❗ **Important**: Although `CGPSConverterConvert` is thread safe (it uses locks to prevent more than one conversion at a time in the same process), it is not thread safe with respect to the Resource Manager.

segments.source: ❗ **Important**: Although `CGPSConverterConvert` is thread safe (it uses locks to prevent more than one conversion at a time in the same process), it is not thread safe with respect to the Resource Manager.
segments.normalizedSource: ❗ **Important**: Although `CGPSConverterConvert` is thread safe (it uses locks to prevent more than one conversion at a time in the same process), it is not thread safe with respect to the Resource Manager.
segments.contextBefore: If a given thread is running a conversion and another thread starts a new conversion, the second conversion will block until the first conversion is complete.
segments.contextAfter: If your application uses the Resource Manager on a separate thread, you should either use locks to prevent `CGPSConverterConvert` from executing during your usage of the Resource Manager or you should perform your conversions using the Post Script converter in a separate process.
